title: 1Password backend systems breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by 1Password, GitHub, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: 1Password is a password manager used by millions of people and many businesses. Only a subset of customers had account details copied, and the company has not said how many.
who_is_affected: Some 1Password customers, whose names, sign-in email addresses and account details were copied. 1Password says vaults were not touched and nobody needs to change anything, but advises caution with unexpected emails about invitations or account recovery.

known.text: 1Password says an attacker gained access to some of its backend systems through an employee's GitHub account.
Names, email addresses and account details of some customers were copied.

not_known.text: How the attacker got into the employee's GitHub account.
